# OpenDDIL Demo - LLM Context

This repository (`openddil-demo`) houses the orchestration and UI for the OpenDDIL "Hero" scenario.

## Purpose
1. Orchestrate the infrastructure via Docker Compose (Redpanda, Postgres, ElectricSQL, Toxiproxy).
2. Simulate LTAMDS radar telemetry and anomalies.
3. Provide React-based Command Center dashboards (Edge, Regional, HQ, and DDIL Controller) using a strict military aesthetic.

## Key Files
- `docker-compose.yml`: Infrastructure orchestration.
- `simulator/ltamds_simulator.py`: Telemetry generator and anomaly trigger.
- `frontend/src/`: React frontend codebase.
  - `Root.tsx`: Navigation wrapper.
  - `App.tsx`: Edge dashboard.
  - `RegionalApp.tsx`: Regional Hub dashboard.
  - `HqApp.tsx`: Strategic Central Command dashboard.
  - `ControllerApp.tsx`: DDIL Degradation Simulator (Toxiproxy controller).

## Rules
- Frontend must use React, Tailwind (Dark Mode), and React Three Fiber.
- Aesthetic must be strict Tier-1 military (slate/zinc backgrounds, neon accents, sharp edges).
- Tactical agents (Faust/Restate) are located in `openddil-tactical-agents`.

## Docker Compose split (HARD RULE)
- `docker-compose.yml` is REGISTRY IMAGES ONLY. Every service references
  `image: ghcr.io/...` (or docker.io, etc). No `build:` directives. No
  source bind-mounts. Customer / CI consumers can run the file directly
  with zero source repos on disk.
- `docker-compose.override.yml` owns every `build:` block, hot-reload
  source mount, and `pull_policy: build`. Compose auto-merges this on
  `docker compose up` from the openddil-demo directory.
- When adding a new service: (1) publish the image to
  `ghcr.io/edgy-solutions/openddil/<service>:latest`, (2) reference via `image:` in
  the base compose, (3) add the matching `build:` block + source mounts
  in the override compose.
- Customer-encumbered services live in
  `openddil-customer-bundle/docker-compose.customer.yml` (sibling repo)
  and are layered via `-f` flags.
